# freeqrcodegen.app

## Summary
freeqrcodegen.app is a free, browser-based QR code generator. It creates scannable QR codes instantly with no login, no cloud processing, and no tracking.

## Key Facts
- 100% client-side — no data is ever sent to a server
- Supports 7 input types: URL, Text, WiFi, Email, Phone, SMS, vCard
- Exports to PNG (up to 2048px), SVG, and JPG — all watermark-free
- Four error correction levels: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), H (30%)
- Custom foreground and background colors with contrast checking
- Works offline after first load via service worker
- No login, no account, no ads, no cookies

## Features
- Live QR code preview as you type (200ms debounce)
- WiFi QR codes with SSID, password, encryption type
- vCard 3.0 contact cards
- Color customization with hex input
- Quiet zone (margin) toggle
- Copy to clipboard as PNG
- Responsive design with dark mode
